drift_policy: the Test gate compares only SCORING_CRITICAL_MODULES against the freeze-time bytes; drift in a reporting module is recorded per dataset (non_critical_drift_since_training) and cannot change a score, so it neither blocks nor unblocks the gate

gpu_ledger_before_test.charging_rule: one A100 per run; training-process wall clock from train.json

test_evaluation_rule: one shot per dataset; mb2_eval.py refuses a dataset absent from this manifest, a checkpoint whose sha256 differs, a changed scoring-critical code module, or a second evaluation
